NNEW CONCEPT ENGLISHBOOK 01 / 新概念英语

BOOK ONE · LESSON 074

What did they do?

他们干了什么？

A bilingual lesson built around eight past-tense illustrations (shaved/cut, took/ate, gave/drunk, met/greeted, went/arrived, worked, enjoyed, swam) practising the 'What did they do?' question with irregular verbs, plus a word table for making eight sentences. Includes textbook written exercises on forming adverbs and writing sentences from the table, a workbook structure exercise on irregular past forms, and grammar on alternative 'or' questions and sentence-making. 以8幅不规则动词过去时插图（刮胡子/割伤、拿/吃、给/喝、遇见/问候、走/到达、工作、享受、游泳）为主的双语课，练习不规则动词一般过去时的「他们干了什么？」问句，并配合词表造句。配合教材副词构词与词表造句的书面练习、教材不规则动词过去式结构练习，以及「or」选择问句和仿照例句造句的语法练习。

01

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Listen and answer the questions.
听录音并回答问题。

What did they do? 他们干了什么？

Listen and answer the questions. What did they do?

He shaved hurriedly this morning and cut himself badly.

他今天早上匆匆忙忙地刮了胡子，把自己割伤得很厉害。

He took a cake and ate it quickly.

他拿了一块蛋糕，很快就把它吃了。

I gave him a glass of water and he drank it thirstily.

我给他一杯水，他渴得很，很快就喝光了。

I met her in the street the day before yesterday and she greeted me warmly.

前天我在街上遇见她，她热情地向我打招呼。

The bus went slowly yesterday afternoon and we arrived home late.

昨天下午公共汽车走得很慢，我们到家很晚。

They worked very hard this morning.

他们今天上午工作得非常努力。

We enjoyed ourselves very much last night.

我们昨天晚上玩得很高兴。

He swam very well this afternoon.

他今天下午游泳游得很好。

New words & expressions 生词和短语

hurriedly /ˈhʌridli/
adv. 匆忙地
cut /kʌt/ (cut /kʌt/)
v. 割, 切
thirstily /ˈθɜːstɪli/
adv. 口渴地
go /ɡəʊ/ (went /went/)
v. 走
greet /ɡriːt/
v. 问候, 打招呼

Written exercises A Look at this. 注意下面的词。

Look at this: quick — quickly; thirsty — thirstily; careful — carefully. Complete these sentences. 模仿例句完成以下句子。

Complete each sentence with the adverb form of the adjective in brackets, following the printed example.

Item Example (She smiled ____. (pleasant) → She smiled pleasantly.) is a printed example and is not editable. Items 1-5 follow the same adjective → adverb pattern.

Written exercises B Look at this table. 注意下表。

Look at this table. Now write eight sentences. 模仿下面的例句，从上面的表格中选出恰当的词和词组，写出8句话。

Using the words in the table, write eight sentences in the simple past, following the printed example 'He read the phrase slowly.'

Word table: subjects (He, She, We, The bus); verbs (does not know, read, smiled, went, shaved, drank, greeted, worked, enjoyed ourselves); objects (a glass of water, the phrase, me, London); adverbs (very hard, hurriedly, slowly, very well, thirstily, warmly, pleasantly, very much). The printed example 'He read the phrase slowly.' is not editable.
